data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 343.077m at the opening of the year. The syndicate recorded adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 7.7m (strengthening of reserves), which the managing agent attributes primarily to the Specialty lines of business. The current year loss ratio was also affected by significant natural catastrophe events (storms Harvey, Irma and Maria and the California wildfires) in the second half of 2017. The prior year movement figure is taken from the managing agent's narrative (explicit amount stated) and has been treated as an adverse prior year development.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure (7.7m) is taken from the managing agent's narrative which explicitly states the amount but does not specify whether this is gross or net of reinsurance; the gross opening reserves were taken from the balance sheet (high confidence). There is some inconsistency between the narrative and the 'Claims incurred' prior-years table (which shows a total of -7,663k) - the narrative describes 'unfavourable' GBP 7.7m while the claims-incurred table appears to show a net release of GBP 7.663m. No explicit gross prior-year movement line was clearly labelled in the technical provisions notes; therefore the narrative amount was used and flagged as lower confidence. Extraction of the gross claims development triangle was possible but some cells and alignments in the printed triangle were ambiguous; the triangle data is included but should be treated with caution.
